# Boxer Wiki

Markdown documentation of [Boxer](https://github.com/n67094/boxer), generated from its headers.

**Do not edit the pages by hand**, they are overwritten by boxer's `docs` workflow every time boxer's `main` branch is updated. Fix the header comments in boxer instead.

Every push to `main` notifies [nsix.blog](https://github.com/n67094/nsix.blog) so it can update its copy of the docs.
